description: radicle-spike's GZCoord integration: its role, p2p-network-dev, is on the fleet's coordination channel — the same relay and channel as every other project of the fleet, hosted on the coordinator's workspace. Read by the GZCoord inbox when the working copy resolves to project radicle-spike; CLAUDE_BRIDGE_URL and GZCOORD_CHANNEL in the environment override it. No token_env_file: the account's token is read from its own secrets.env (ADR-038 rule 9). relay_runtime_dir is relative to the workspace, never inside a repository. Written 2026-10-07 when the spike became a managed project.
